summary: Initial Chat 6 scope is complete and ready for deterministic cohort integration. The Control Plane provides candidate/schema/vocabulary/reference/write-ownership/hash/zero-loss/collision/Atlasfin/NDC reconciliation validation, proposal-only composer planning, Visual Current Truth, Surface Readiness, and bounded Work Entry anti-rediscovery hardening. The temporary workflow-authored global FILES_MANIFEST.json contamination was removed and no forbidden global file remains in the final lane diff.
findings: Factory Ledger capability visual.generic_application_engine_v1 is DONE/SOURCE_READY with doNotRebuild=true; Chat 6 reused and advanced existing machinery rather than rebuilding it.
Current Visual Control census and Target Index are reusable physical truth. DISCOVERY_ONLY is not UNDISCOVERED and broad recensus is not a legal shortcut.
Atlasfin structured registries are the priority visual reference for this cohort. Materiality Catalog was never inspected or used as fallback and remains STANDBY_USER_INVOKED_ONLY.
PRISMA GVAE All-Surface Authority auto-materialized prisma-html/FILES_MANIFEST.json while PR #541 was open. Closing that PR stopped the lane-branch mutation loop.
Final work tree is byte-equivalent to the CI-validated code head cb21ca01ecf8ec755fe34820d3d5b34673f70581: compare cb21..7cc48f reports zero changed files.
decisions: Preserve exactly GVAE_EXACT_APPLY, SURFACE_BATCH_PLAN, REGISTER_TARGET_FIRST and BLOCKED as Work Entry decisions.
Use REUSE_EXISTING_CENSUS_SEMANTIC_PROMOTION_REQUIRED and BROAD_REDISCOVERY_FORBIDDEN_CURRENT_CENSUS as machine-readable reasons, never as new decisions.
Canonical composer remains proposal-only: no canonical IDs assigned, no canonical registry mutation and no product/runtime mutation.
Candidate data remains candidate-only and authority-qualified; candidate is not authority and resolved binding is not mutation authorization.
Close PR #541 rather than keep allowing PR automation to write a forbidden global integration output onto the lane branch.
Leave FILES_MANIFEST.json unchanged from base on the Chat 6 lane. The interoperability contract assigns its one-time refresh to the later integration stage.
